justification: Intelligence Brief QA corrections, frontend/presentation-layer only — no backend, DB query, or schema change. Verified against a live stream of the brief for an E1 (Local Centre) heritage lot (100 Ramsay St, Haberfield), confirming the backend genuinely returns dev_type=dwelling_house / as_of_right_dwellings=1 on E1 (a prohibited form) — the render layer now fail-closes it. Fixes: (1) capacity card drops the 'buildable without council approval' claim ('as-of-right, subject to a DA') and, because the yield + residential-setback model only covers R1-R5/RU5, suppresses the yield/DCP-adjusted-GFA/setback tiles on non-residential zones with a note (LEP GFA envelope still shows); the card is now passed zone={planningCtx.zone} so the gate fires; (2) residential DCP controls card caveated on non-residential zones; (3) coastal SEPP 'land application' layer relabelled 'Coastal Management Area' and the coastal_hazards field rendered as a single jurisdictional line (not a doubled label or hazard finding); (4) Pre-DA filtered out of Data Gaps; (5) bushfire that resolved to 'not bushfire-prone' (value present, category null) is suppressed from Data Gaps so the gap no longer contradicts the card; (6) the additional_permitted_uses overlay's bare LEP code (e.g. '51') renders as 'Applies (ref 51) — see LEP', not a meaningless number; (7) cosmetics — serialised empties render as an em dash, lowercase snake_case enums (not_strata) are humanised, currency fields are $-prefixed.

break_it.scenario: Backend sends a residential dwelling-house yield for a non-residential zone (E1/B4/IN1) where a dwelling is prohibited
break_it.what_happens: the brief would assert a buildable dwelling count and residential setbacks that do not apply, misstating capacity on a commercial lot
break_it.repro: run a brief for a centre-zone address (e.g. an E1 Haberfield lot) and inspect the Development Yield Estimate card
break_it.how: zoneModelled gates the yield, DCP-adjusted GFA and setback tiles to zones matching /^(R[1-5]|RU5)\b/; non-residential zones show only the LEP GFA envelope plus a note that yield is delivered via the zone's permitted uses (e.g. shop-top housing). The card is now passed zone={planningCtx.zone} so the gate actually fires.

break_it.scenario: Zone is unknown/empty because the planning section failed to populate planningCtx.zone
break_it.what_happens: over-suppression could hide a valid residential yield, or the relabel could mis-fire
break_it.repro: render the card with zone undefined (planning portal section absent or errored)
break_it.how: zoneModelled defaults to true when zone is falsy (!zone), so an unknown zone falls back to showing the yield rather than wrongly suppressing it; suppression only happens when we positively know the zone is non-residential.

break_it.scenario: formatValue receives a legitimate string that looks like a snake_case enum or contains the word none
break_it.what_happens: a real value could be mangled into an em dash or unexpectedly title-cased
break_it.repro: feed formatValue a value such as 'Land Application', 'none of the above', or 'low_density'
break_it.how: the empty collapse only matches the whole trimmed string against /^(none|null|nan|undefined)$/i (anchored), so 'none of the above' is untouched; humanisation only matches all-lowercase snake_case (/^[a-z0-9]+(_[a-z0-9]+)+$/), so mixed-case/spaced values like 'Land Application' pass through unchanged.

break_it.scenario: A non-currency numeric field is wrongly prefixed with $, or a currency field arrives as a pre-formatted string
break_it.what_happens: incorrect $ prefixes on areas/ratios, or a missing $ on land value
break_it.repro: render an Economics section with land_value as a number and lot_size as a number
break_it.how: the $ prefix is gated on an explicit CURRENCY_FIELDS allow-list AND typeof raw === 'number', so only known currency keys with numeric values get the prefix; everything else uses the existing unit-suffix path.

break_it.scenario: Bushfire prescreen genuinely fails (no value object) but the gap is hidden anyway
break_it.what_happens: a real 'we could not determine bushfire status' gap is silently dropped, hiding missing data
break_it.repro: stream a brief where satellite.bushfire returns confidence not_available with value null (total failure, not a not-prone resolution)
break_it.how: the gap is only added to hiddenGapFields when the bushfire value is a present object with category == null (the 'ran, not prone' case the card resolves); a null/absent value fails the guard so the genuine gap still shows.

break_it.scenario: additional_permitted_uses overlay returns an unexpected value (empty, or a real word rather than a code)
break_it.what_happens: the 'Applies (ref X) — see LEP' wrapper could render an empty ref or wrap a value that isn't a code
break_it.repro: feed OverlayList an additional_permitted_uses row with value '' and one with value 'Permitted'
break_it.how: the wrapper only applies when formatValue(o.value) !== '—' (so empty/None values fall through to the em dash), and it presents whatever the overlay returns as a reference pointing back to the LEP rather than asserting any specific use.

post_merge.other_repo: N/A - frontend-only; no backend or Trigger.dev/Railway change. The capacity engine and DCP fetchers are untouched; this only changes how their output is rendered.
post_merge.manual_verify: Open the Intelligence Brief for a non-residential-zone address (e.g. an E1 Haberfield lot): the Development Yield Estimate shows the GFA envelope plus a 'not modelled for this zone' note (no dwelling count, no residential setbacks), the DCP card carries a non-residential caveat, the coastal row reads 'Coastal Management Area', no Pre-DA line appears in Data Gaps, and any 'not_strata'/empty/land-value fields render cleanly. Then open a residential R-zone address and confirm the yield range still renders normally.
